sources.title: Moonshot AI's AGI Vision
sources.by: Yang Zhilin (interviewed by Overseas Unicorn; trans. ChinaTalk)
sources.quote_checked: AI, at its core, is just a set of scaling laws. | To achieve AGI, long-context will be a crucial factor. | The lossless long-context technology we recently developed performs better than OpenAI in many specific scenarios. | If you have a billion-token context length, then the problems we face today would no longer be problems. | I personally feel that there is a Moore's Law for context length. | architectures worth scaling need to have both scalability and generality. | lossless compression is essentially the process of learning determinism from chaos. | Probability is really a method of general-purpose representation. | we can become a company that combines OpenAI's technology idealism with the business philosophy of ByteDance. | I firmly believe AGI will be inherently global. | AGI does not require that many people.
